params.text: The approved palette. Every swatch is bound to its variable, so a token change moves the swatch.
The approved pairings, drawn as they are used. gnosix is a substrate system: the palette is fixed, the pairing carries the meaning.
Space Grotesk, the only visual family. Weights are the ratified four; the technical style adds tabular figures.
A design source of truth your agents can edit, render and hand off as code.

The ratified spacing steps. Each bar is bound to its variable, so the scale is the same scale the code uses.
The ratified glyphs and identity masters, imported as editable layers. Nothing here is a picture of a thing.

properties.rule: Preserve each ratified cube master as authored, including dark-face assignment, symbol, material response and local color modulation.

params.label: Preserve each ratified cube master as authored, including dark-face assignment, symbol, material response and local color modulation.

properties.rule: Use Syster as the universal organizational logo or infer behavior from mascot artwork.

params.label: Use Syster as the universal organizational logo or infer behavior from mascot artwork.

properties.rule: Regenerate, perspective-transform, re-typeset or geometrically normalize a ratified identity master as an implementation shortcut.

params.label: Regenerate, perspective-transform, re-typeset or geometrically normalize a ratified identity master as an implementation shortcut.

properties.rule: Composite a ratified alpha identity master over a chromatic substrate. Alpha masters are sanctioned on neutral substrates only.

params.label: Composite a ratified alpha identity master over a chromatic substrate. Alpha masters are sanctioned on neutral substrates only.

properties.rule: Use Space Grotesk as the primary family for interface and authored reference text; do not apply this rule to glyphs already baked into ratified identity artwork.

params.label: Use Space Grotesk as the primary family for interface and authored reference text; do not apply this rule to glyphs already baked into ratified identity artwork.

properties.rule: Express technical or evidence text with the technical family — IBM Plex Mono — and, where the field says so, with Space Grotesk using weight, tracking and tabular numerals.

params.label: Express technical or evidence text with the technical family — IBM Plex Mono — and, where the field says so, with Space Grotesk using weight, tracking and tabular numerals.

properties.rule: Read exact approved colors from core/TOKENS.json and generate platform projections from it.

params.label: Read exact approved colors from core/TOKENS.json and generate platform projections from it.

properties.rule: Put anthracite essential normal text on Signal Orange — it measures 6.43 — and never white, which measures 2.87 and would not read.

params.label: Put anthracite essential normal text on Signal Orange — it measures 6.43 — and never white, which measures 2.87 and would not read.

properties.rule: Declare quantity, range, neutral point if applicable, endpoints, missing state and legend for a scalar field.

params.label: Declare quantity, range, neutral point if applicable, endpoints, missing state and legend for a scalar field.

properties.rule: Project an intended mutation as observed success before observation or reconciliation.

params.label: Project an intended mutation as observed success before observation or reconciliation.

properties.rule: Introduce a rounded status, metadata, category, filter, choice or count capsule under any name.

params.label: Introduce a rounded status, metadata, category, filter, choice or count capsule under any name.

properties.rule: Keep geometry, material, chrome, depth, content, input geometry and allocation independently representable where applicable.

params.label: Keep geometry, material, chrome, depth, content, input geometry and allocation independently representable where applicable.

properties.rule: Provide a non-color state cue, an accessible name and visible focus for applicable interactive content.

params.label: Provide a non-color state cue, an accessible name and visible focus for applicable interactive content.

properties.rule: Honor reduced motion and keep asynchronous transitions interruptible.

params.label: Honor reduced motion and keep asynchronous transitions interruptible.

properties.rule: Draw interface glyphs from the ratified Tabler subset in assets/icons/. Do not hand-author an SVG glyph, borrow a glyph from another set, or substitute a text character for an icon.

params.label: Draw interface glyphs from the ratified Tabler subset in assets/icons/. Do not hand-author an SVG glyph, borrow a glyph from another set, or substitute a text character for an icon.

properties.rule: A published token name is the layer id, kebab-cased, under the --gnosix- prefix. No projection may rename a layer id, and no consumer may write a name the system does not publish.

params.label: A published token name is the layer id, kebab-cased, under the --gnosix- prefix. No projection may rename a layer id, and no consumer may write a name the system does not publish.

properties.rule: A product may carry its own content palette for what it is showing — a diagram, a chart, a data visualisation, a category of thing — provided it is declared and provided it does not carry the interface. The interface is the system's; the content is the product's.

params.label: A product may carry its own content palette for what it is showing — a diagram, a chart, a data visualisation, a category of thing — provided it is declared and provided it does not carry the interface. The interface is the system's; the content is the product's.

properties.rule: A scheme that changes the ink changes the ground the ink is written on. The system's grounds are not dark enough to carry every ink, so a scheme carries the grounds its own ink needs.

params.label: A scheme that changes the ink changes the ground the ink is written on. The system's grounds are not dark enough to carry every ink, so a scheme carries the grounds its own ink needs.

properties.rule: Compose first, paint once. A surface is composed into one canonical boundary before it is filled or stroked: semantic regions compose into a single material boundary, and the surface is painted by one path and one owner.

params.label: Compose first, paint once. A surface is composed into one canonical boundary before it is filled or stroked: semantic regions compose into a single material boundary, and the surface is painted by one path and one owner.

properties.rule: The curvature of a shell is one authority for the whole composition. A region does not carry a radius of its own, and a window's rounding is the shell's rounding.

params.label: The curvature of a shell is one authority for the whole composition. A region does not carry a radius of its own, and a window's rounding is the shell's rounding.

properties.rule: A settled surface is a canonical state rebuilt from the composition, not the residue of an animation. A transition has no independently renderable primitive, and a rebuild at rest equals a fresh build.

params.label: A settled surface is a canonical state rebuilt from the composition, not the residue of an animation. A transition has no independently renderable primitive, and a rebuild at rest equals a fresh build.

properties.rule: A surface's occupancy is stated, never inferred from its dimensions, and each output resolves its own policy. A compositor's fullscreen is an explicit occupancy class.

params.label: A surface's occupancy is stated, never inferred from its dimensions, and each output resolves its own policy. A compositor's fullscreen is an explicit occupancy class.

properties.rule: A configuration epoch isolates what a profile may not bleed into another. Private motion state does not cross an epoch.

params.label: A configuration epoch isolates what a profile may not bleed into another. Private motion state does not cross an epoch.

properties.rule: A surface's axes are ordered. One axis settles before the next begins, and a settled axis carries no residue into the next.

params.label: A surface's axes are ordered. One axis settles before the next begins, and a settled axis carries no residue into the next.

properties.rule: The topology of a surface is not its behaviour. A topology says how the material is arranged; the policies — the workarea, the fullscreen response, the overlap response — are stated beside it and are never inferred from it.

params.label: The topology of a surface is not its behaviour. A topology says how the material is arranged; the policies — the workarea, the fullscreen response, the overlap response — are stated beside it and are never inferred from it.

properties.rule: A surface that a policy suppresses paints nothing, and no boundary of it remains in the surface.

params.label: A surface that a policy suppresses paints nothing, and no boundary of it remains in the surface.

properties.rule: A surface's geometry is finite. No non-finite value reaches a path, an axis or a wave.

params.label: A surface's geometry is finite. No non-finite value reaches a path, an axis or a wave.

properties.rule: A role that carries text is measured against the ground it is written on, and the pairing measures at least 4.5:1. A role that carries a mark measures at least 3:1, and the ground where it does not reach it is excluded from the role.

params.label: A role that carries text is measured against the ground it is written on, and the pairing measures at least 4.5:1. A role that carries a mark measures at least 3:1, and the ground where it does not reach it is excluded from the role.
